message: Nothing like a little family game night by lantern light during a blackout! We swapped our usual cell phone screens for some good old-fashioned board games and a lively group chat. It’s funny how these unexpected moments can bring us all together. What’s your favorite way to stay cozy when the lights go out? 🌟
